tagline.en-MY: A fictional Malaysian kampung of shoplots, timber houses and a quiet lake.
tagline.ms-MY: Sebuah kampung Malaysia rekaan dengan rumah kedai, rumah kayu dan tasik yang tenang.

description.en-MY: Your timber house on stilts, with a breezy serambi verandah. Collect rent from the letterbox.
description.ms-MY: Rumah kayu bertiang anda dengan serambi yang berangin. Kutip sewa dari peti surat.

description.en-MY: A cosy wooden house for a growing kampung.
description.ms-MY: Rumah papan yang selesa untuk kampung yang berkembang.

description.en-MY: A bright two-storey terrace home with a little front porch.
description.ms-MY: Rumah teres dua tingkat yang terang dengan anjung kecil.

description.en-MY: A corner shoplot coffee shop with marble tables under the five-foot way.
description.ms-MY: Kedai kopi di rumah kedai simpang dengan meja marmar di kaki lima.

perks.en-MY: Marble tables on the five-foot way

description.en-MY: Mei bakes soft loaves every morning — and coconut kuih, if you help her.
description.ms-MY: Mei membakar roti lembut setiap pagi — dan kuih kelapa, kalau awak bantu.

description.en-MY: Raised beds of bunga raya, kelapa seedlings and vegetables for the whole kampung.
description.ms-MY: Batas tanaman bunga raya, anak kelapa dan sayur-sayuran untuk seluruh kampung.

description.en-MY: Turns garden blooms into jambangan and garlands.
description.ms-MY: Mengubah bunga kebun menjadi jambangan dan kalungan.

description.en-MY: Arjun saws papan, fires bata and weaves rattan — the materials for every upgrade.
description.ms-MY: Arjun menggergaji papan, membakar bata dan menganyam rotan — bahan untuk setiap naik taraf.

description.en-MY: The kampung sundry shop: baskets of produce, jars of kaya and everything in between.
description.ms-MY: Kedai runcit kampung: bakul hasil tani, balang kaya dan segala-galanya.

description.en-MY: A bright glass showroom. Arrange the cars on display; neighbours drop by to look and chat.
description.ms-MY: Bilik pameran kaca yang terang. Susun kereta pameran; jiran singgah untuk melihat dan bersembang.

description.en-MY: A friendly after-school learning centre with a daily quiz.
description.ms-MY: Pusat belajar selepas sekolah yang mesra dengan kuiz harian.

description.en-MY: A shady park where neighbours relax under the rain trees.
description.ms-MY: Taman redup tempat jiran berehat di bawah pokok hujan-hujan.

description.en-MY: The kampung community hall, for community dinners, meetings and rainy-day badminton. Adds an order slot.
description.ms-MY: Dewan komuniti kampung, untuk makan malam bersama, mesyuarat dan badminton hari hujan. Menambah satu slot pesanan.

description.en-MY: Neighbours pin their requests here.
description.ms-MY: Jiran menampal permintaan mereka di sini.

description.en-MY: Selamat datang ke Kampung Seri!
description.ms-MY: Selamat datang ke Kampung Seri!

description.en-MY: A calm lake with a little jetty. Good for fishing — catch and release.
description.ms-MY: Tasik tenang dengan jeti kecil. Sesuai untuk memancing — tangkap dan lepas.

description.en-MY: An open-sided pavilion by the lake, built together through gotong-royong.
description.ms-MY: Pondok terbuka di tepi tasik, dibina bersama secara gotong-royong.

description.en-MY: A wide, shady canopy.
description.ms-MY: Kanopi luas dan redup.

description.en-MY: Tall and swaying in the breeze.
description.ms-MY: Tinggi dan melambai ditiup angin.

description.en-MY: Bursts of pink paper petals all year.
description.ms-MY: Kelopak kertas merah jambu sepanjang tahun.

description.en-MY: Bright red blooms.
description.ms-MY: Bunga merah yang terang.

description.en-MY: A patch of orchids and marigolds.
description.ms-MY: Sepetak orkid dan bunga tahi ayam.

description.en-MY: Neighbours sit and chat here.
description.ms-MY: Jiran duduk dan bersembang di sini.

description.en-MY: Glows warmly at night.
description.ms-MY: Bercahaya hangat pada waktu malam.

description.en-MY: A simple bamboo fence.
description.ms-MY: Pagar buluh yang ringkas.

description.en-MY: Lemongrass, pandan and chilli.
description.ms-MY: Serai, pandan dan cili.

description.en-MY: Smooth and mossy.
description.ms-MY: Licin dan berlumut.

description.en-MY: Broad leaves, perfect shade for the cat.
description.ms-MY: Daun lebar, teduhan sempurna untuk kucing.

description.en-MY: Traditional clay water jars.
description.ms-MY: Tempayan tanah liat tradisional.

description.en-MY: Fresh produce on display.
description.ms-MY: Hasil segar dipamerkan.

description.en-MY: The postman stops here.
description.ms-MY: Posmen singgah di sini.

description.en-MY: Uncle Lim’s thank-you gift.
description.ms-MY: Hadiah terima kasih Pak Cik Lim.

description.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab’s keepsake: the bulbuls love it.
description.ms-MY: Kenangan Mak Cik Zainab: burung merbah sangat suka.

description.en-MY: Mei’s kuih-sale table.
description.ms-MY: Meja jualan kuih Mei.

description.en-MY: Kampung Flower Festival reward.
description.ms-MY: Ganjaran Pesta Bunga Kampung.

description.en-MY: A post hung with warm garden lanterns.
description.ms-MY: Tiang dengan lampu taman yang hangat.

description.en-MY: Marks the year the lakeside pavilion was built together.
description.ms-MY: Menandakan tahun pondok tepi tasik dibina bersama.

description.en-MY: An overgrown corner by the rain trees. Neighbours want a pocket park with a picnic lawn.
description.ms-MY: Sudut semak di tepi pokok hujan. Jiran-jiran mahu taman poket dengan laman berkelah.

description.en-MY: An empty square that could host the kampung’s night market.
description.ms-MY: Dataran kosong yang boleh menjadi tapak pasar malam kampung.

description.en-MY: A bare lot where the kampung kids dream of swings and a slide.
description.ms-MY: Tanah lapang tempat kanak-kanak kampung mengimpikan buaian dan gelongsor.

description.en-MY: A gentle rise with the best sunset view in Kampung Seri.
description.ms-MY: Bukit landai dengan pemandangan matahari terbenam terbaik di Kampung Seri.

description.en-MY: A wau kite from the playground’s opening day.
description.ms-MY: Wau dari hari pembukaan taman permainan.

description.en-MY: Open early, open late: roti canai off the griddle and nasi lemak to share.
description.ms-MY: Buka awal pagi hingga lewat malam: roti canai panas dan nasi lemak untuk dikongsi.

description.en-MY: Strong, sweet and brewed through a cloth sock.
description.ms-MY: Pekat, manis dan dibancuh melalui kain saring.

description.en-MY: A soft white loaf.
description.ms-MY: Sebuku roti putih yang lembut.

description.en-MY: Bright hibiscus blooms.
description.ms-MY: Bunga raya yang terang.

description.en-MY: A fresh coconut.
description.ms-MY: Sebiji kelapa segar.

description.en-MY: Kangkung, long beans and chillies.
description.ms-MY: Kangkung, kacang panjang dan cili.

description.en-MY: Kopi and roti bakar — the perfect start.
description.ms-MY: Kopi dan roti bakar — permulaan yang sempurna.

description.en-MY: Mei’s coconut kuih, version twelve.
description.ms-MY: Kuih kelapa Mei, versi kedua belas.

description.en-MY: A hand-tied bouquet.
description.ms-MY: Jambangan bunga yang diikat tangan.

description.en-MY: A festival garland of jasmine and marigold.
description.ms-MY: Kalungan pesta daripada melur dan bunga tahi ayam.

description.en-MY: Timber planks for upgrades.
description.ms-MY: Papan kayu untuk naik taraf.

description.en-MY: Sturdy red bricks.
description.ms-MY: Bata merah yang kukuh.

description.en-MY: Woven by Arjun.
description.ms-MY: Dianyam oleh Arjun.

description.en-MY: A generous market basket.
description.ms-MY: Bakul pasar yang penuh.

description.en-MY: Coconut jam, slow-stirred for hours.
description.ms-MY: Seri kaya, dikacau perlahan berjam-jam.

bio.en-MY: Ran his father’s corner kopitiam for thirty years before it closed. Remembers every regular’s order and grows orchids on the back steps.
bio.ms-MY: Mengusahakan kopitiam di simpang milik ayahnya selama tiga puluh tahun sebelum ia ditutup. Ingat pesanan setiap pelanggan tetap dan menanam orkid di tangga belakang.

text.en-MY: Ah, you’re here! Come, sit — the kettle is always on.
text.ms-MY: Ha, sampai pun! Mari duduk — cerek sentiasa panas.

text.en-MY: Morning! Best time of day. The air still smells of rain.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Masa paling baik. Udara masih bau hujan.

text.en-MY: Evening already? The shutters are half down, but for you, still open.
text.ms-MY: Dah petang? Pintu besi separuh tutup, tapi untuk awak, masih buka.

text.en-MY: Can’t sleep either? I’m soaking tomorrow’s coffee beans.
text.ms-MY: Tak boleh tidur juga? Saya sedang rendam biji kopi untuk esok.

text.en-MY: A good kopi is like a good neighbour — strong, warm and always there in the morning.
text.ms-MY: Kopi yang baik macam jiran yang baik — pekat, hangat dan sentiasa ada waktu pagi.

text.en-MY: My father roasted his own beans with a little butter and sugar. I still do it his way.
text.ms-MY: Ayah saya goreng biji kopi sendiri dengan sedikit mentega dan gula. Saya masih ikut caranya.

text.en-MY: When it rains, everyone squeezes under the five-foot way. Best conversations happen there.
text.ms-MY: Bila hujan, semua orang berteduh di kaki lima. Sembang paling seronok berlaku di situ.

text.en-MY: Mei says I should add a pandan menu. Maybe. Don’t tell her I said maybe.
text.ms-MY: Mei kata saya patut tambah menu pandan. Mungkin. Jangan beritahu dia saya kata mungkin.

text.en-MY: I thought I would just sit at home after retiring. You gave this old man his mornings back.
text.ms-MY: Saya ingat lepas bersara saya cuma duduk di rumah. Awak pulangkan pagi saya.

text.en-MY: Every time I pull the shutters up, I remember the day you helped me reopen.
text.ms-MY: Setiap kali saya angkat pintu besi, saya ingat hari awak bantu saya buka semula kedai.

text.en-MY: The new tables out front — people stay for a second cup now.
text.ms-MY: Meja baru di depan — orang duduk lama untuk cawan kedua sekarang.

text.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab’s pavilion by the lake — my afternoon kopi tastes better there.
text.ms-MY: Pondok Mak Cik Zainab tepi tasik — kopi petang saya lebih sedap di situ.

love.en-MY: Wah, this is my favourite! You remembered.
love.ms-MY: Wah, ini kegemaran saya! Awak ingat lagi.

neutral.en-MY: Thank you! I’ll find a good use for it.
neutral.ms-MY: Terima kasih! Saya akan guna dengan baik.

bio.en-MY: Trained in a big hotel kitchen, came home to bake for people she actually knows. Experiments with pandan and gula melaka.
bio.ms-MY: Pernah bekerja di dapur hotel besar, pulang ke kampung untuk membakar roti bagi orang yang dikenalinya. Suka mencuba pandan dan gula melaka.

text.en-MY: Hi! Mind the tray — it’s still hot.
text.ms-MY: Hai! Hati-hati dulang tu — masih panas.

text.en-MY: Morning! The first loaves just came out.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Roti pertama baru keluar dari ketuhar.

text.en-MY: Evening! I’m proofing dough for tomorrow.
text.ms-MY: Selamat petang! Saya sedang naikkan doh untuk esok.

text.en-MY: Bread is patient. You can’t rush it, only love it.
text.ms-MY: Roti perlukan sabar. Tak boleh gopoh, cuma sayang.

text.en-MY: Uncle Lim pretends he doesn’t like my kaya. He’s had three slices today.
text.ms-MY: Pak Cik Lim buat-buat tak suka kaya saya. Dah tiga keping hari ini.

text.en-MY: I’m working on a coconut kuih that doesn’t fall apart. Version eleven.
text.ms-MY: Saya sedang cuba kuih kelapa yang tak mudah hancur. Versi kesebelas.

text.en-MY: Baking for neighbours feels different from a hotel. Here, I see you smile.
text.ms-MY: Membakar untuk jiran rasa lain daripada di hotel. Di sini, saya nampak awak senyum.

text.en-MY: The day the bakery opened, I baked until midnight out of pure happiness.
text.ms-MY: Hari kedai roti dibuka, saya bakar sampai tengah malam sebab terlalu gembira.

text.en-MY: Remember the bake sale? Gone in an hour!
text.ms-MY: Ingat jualan amal kuih? Habis dalam sejam!

love.en-MY: Oh! This is exactly what I needed for a new recipe!
love.ms-MY: Oh! Ini betul-betul yang saya perlukan untuk resipi baharu!

neutral.en-MY: Thanks! I’ll put it to good use.

bio.en-MY: Taught primary science for thirty-four years. Knows the name of every plant in the kampung and most of the birds.
bio.ms-MY: Mengajar Sains sekolah rendah selama tiga puluh empat tahun. Tahu nama setiap pokok di kampung dan kebanyakan burung.

text.en-MY: Selamat pagi! Come, look at the bunga raya today.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Mari, tengok bunga raya hari ini.

text.en-MY: Good morning. The dew is still on the leaves — best time to water.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi. Embun masih di daun — masa terbaik untuk menyiram.

text.en-MY: The sun is going down. Listen — the birds are saying goodnight.
text.ms-MY: Matahari dah terbenam. Dengar — burung sedang ucap selamat malam.

text.en-MY: A garden teaches patience better than any classroom.
text.ms-MY: Kebun mengajar sabar lebih baik daripada mana-mana bilik darjah.

text.en-MY: Lemongrass by the door, pandan by the drain. My mother’s rule.
text.ms-MY: Serai di tepi pintu, pandan di tepi longkang. Petua emak saya.

text.en-MY: When the children help me plant, they ask a hundred questions. I answer every one.
text.ms-MY: Bila budak-budak tolong saya menanam, mereka tanya seratus soalan. Saya jawab semuanya.

text.en-MY: You have good hands for growing things. I can tell.
text.ms-MY: Tangan awak sejuk, sesuai untuk bercucuk tanam. Saya boleh nampak.

text.en-MY: The first sprout in our kebun — I still have the photo.
text.ms-MY: Tunas pertama di kebun kita — gambarnya masih saya simpan.

text.en-MY: Our pavilion by the lake — built by everyone. Just like the old days.
text.ms-MY: Pondok kita tepi tasik — dibina bersama. Macam zaman dulu.

love.en-MY: Wah, cantiknya! You know me so well.
love.ms-MY: Wah, cantiknya! Awak memang kenal saya.

bio.en-MY: Makes rattan chairs the way his grandfather taught him, and coaches the kampung kids’ football on Saturdays.
bio.ms-MY: Membuat kerusi rotan seperti yang diajar datuknya, dan melatih bola sepak budak-budak kampung setiap Sabtu.

text.en-MY: Yo! Careful, sawdust everywhere.
text.ms-MY: Hai! Hati-hati, habuk kayu di mana-mana.

text.en-MY: Morning! Wood cuts cleanest before the heat.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Kayu paling elok dipotong sebelum panas.

text.en-MY: Measure twice, cut once. Same with friendships, actually.
text.ms-MY: Ukur dua kali, potong sekali. Persahabatan pun sama, sebenarnya.

text.en-MY: The kids want a proper goalpost. I’m on it.
text.ms-MY: Budak-budak nak tiang gol yang betul. Saya sedang buat.

text.en-MY: Rattan bends but it doesn’t break. Good lesson.
text.ms-MY: Rotan boleh lentur tapi tak patah. Pengajaran yang baik.

text.en-MY: This bengkel is the best thing that happened to me. Thank you, really.
text.ms-MY: Bengkel ini perkara terbaik yang pernah berlaku pada saya. Terima kasih, betul.

bio.en-MY: Runs after-school lessons with endless patience and a cupboard full of puzzle books. Believes every question is a good one.
bio.ms-MY: Mengendalikan kelas selepas sekolah dengan penuh sabar dan almari penuh buku teka-teki. Percaya setiap soalan ialah soalan yang baik.

text.en-MY: Hello! Ready for today’s question?
text.ms-MY: Hai! Sedia untuk soalan hari ini?

text.en-MY: Good morning! Fresh minds learn fastest.
text.ms-MY: Selamat pagi! Minda yang segar cepat belajar.

text.en-MY: Getting an answer wrong is just learning in progress.
text.ms-MY: Tersalah jawab cuma tanda sedang belajar.

text.en-MY: I keep a jar of jasmine on my desk. It makes the room calmer.
text.ms-MY: Saya simpan sebalang melur di atas meja. Bilik terasa lebih tenang.

text.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab taught me science when I was nine. Now we swap books.
text.ms-MY: Mak Cik Zainab ajar saya Sains masa saya sembilan tahun. Sekarang kami bertukar buku.

text.en-MY: Our little learning centre — every chair filled after school. Because of you.
text.ms-MY: Pusat belajar kecil kita — setiap kerusi penuh selepas sekolah. Kerana awak.

love.en-MY: For me? How lovely — thank you!

bio.en-MY: Has a clipboard for every occasion and a plan for every rainy day. Organises the kampung’s gotong-royong and the night market stalls.
bio.ms-MY: Ada papan klip untuk setiap majlis dan rancangan untuk setiap hari hujan. Menggerakkan gotong-royong kampung dan gerai pasar malam.

text.en-MY: There you are! I have ideas. Many ideas.
text.ms-MY: Ha, jumpa pun! Saya ada idea. Banyak idea.

text.en-MY: Evening! Perfect weather for a gathering.
text.ms-MY: Petang! Cuaca sesuai untuk berkumpul.

text.en-MY: Gotong-royong works because nobody is too important to sweep.
text.ms-MY: Gotong-royong berjaya sebab tiada siapa terlalu penting untuk menyapu.

text.en-MY: Next on my list: lanterns along the lake path.
text.ms-MY: Seterusnya dalam senarai saya: lampu di sepanjang laluan tasik.

text.en-MY: You never say no when the kampung needs help. People notice.
text.ms-MY: Awak tak pernah menolak bila kampung perlukan bantuan. Orang perasan.

text.en-MY: The taman opening — the whole kampung came!
text.ms-MY: Perasmian taman — satu kampung datang!

love.en-MY: Oh, I love this! Perfect for the next event!
love.ms-MY: Oh, saya suka! Sesuai untuk acara seterusnya!

neutral.en-MY: Thanks! I’ll find a use for it.

bio.en-MY: Restores old cars on weekends and explains engines so simply that even Uncle Lim understands. Honest to a fault.
bio.ms-MY: Membaik pulih kereta lama pada hujung minggu dan menerangkan enjin dengan begitu mudah sehingga Pak Cik Lim pun faham. Jujur orangnya.

text.en-MY: Hey! Come see how the light hits the paint today.
text.ms-MY: Hai! Mari tengok cahaya pada cat kereta hari ini.

text.en-MY: Morning! Polishing before the visitors arrive.
text.ms-MY: Pagi! Menggilap sebelum pelawat sampai.

text.en-MY: A good showroom is about the story, not the shine.
text.ms-MY: Bilik pameran yang baik tentang ceritanya, bukan kilatnya.

text.en-MY: Try arranging the cars by colour. It feels like a garden.
text.ms-MY: Cuba susun kereta ikut warna. Rasa macam taman.

text.en-MY: I like that people here just come to look and chat. No pressure.
text.ms-MY: Saya suka orang di sini datang tengok dan bersembang sahaja. Tiada tekanan.

text.en-MY: The showroom’s first morning — I polished every car twice.
text.ms-MY: Pagi pertama bilik pameran — saya gilap setiap kereta dua kali.

love.en-MY: Seriously? This is great, thank you!

bio.en-MY: Grew up in Sabah with Mount Kinabalu outside her window. Photographs sunsets, shopfronts and the people who make a place feel like home.
bio.ms-MY: Membesar di Sabah dengan Gunung Kinabalu di luar tingkap. Merakam matahari terbenam, deretan kedai dan orang yang menjadikan sesuatu tempat terasa seperti rumah.

text.en-MY: Hold still — the light is perfect! …Okay, hi!
text.ms-MY: Jangan bergerak — cahayanya sempurna! …Okey, hai!

text.en-MY: Try photo mode by the lake at sunset. Trust me.
text.ms-MY: Cuba mod foto tepi tasik waktu senja. Percayalah.

text.en-MY: Your kampung has real character. The rain makes everything glow.
text.ms-MY: Kampung awak ada jiwa. Hujan buat semuanya bersinar.

text.en-MY: The rumah teres has the best window light I’ve ever had.
text.ms-MY: Rumah teres ini ada cahaya tingkap paling cantik pernah saya dapat.

love.en-MY: I need a photo of this first!
love.ms-MY: Saya nak ambil gambar ini dulu!

intro.en-MY: Welcome to Kampung Seri! I’m Uncle Lim, from the shoplot on the corner. Your house has been collecting rent while you unpacked — tap the coins above it!
intro.ms-MY: Selamat datang ke Kampung Seri! Saya Pak Cik Lim, dari rumah kedai di simpang. Rumah awak dah kumpul sewa semasa awak berkemas — ketik syiling di atasnya!

outro.en-MY: See? This little kampung already looks after you.
outro.ms-MY: Nampak? Kampung kecil ini dah jaga awak.

why.en-MY: Houses earn coins over time — even while you’re away.
why.ms-MY: Rumah menjana syiling dari masa ke masa — walaupun anda tiada.

intro.en-MY: My father’s kopitiam has been closed since I retired. The shoplot is still there, just waiting… Will you help me open it again?
intro.ms-MY: Kopitiam ayah saya ditutup sejak saya bersara. Rumah kedainya masih ada, menunggu… Sudikah awak bantu saya buka semula?

outro.en-MY: The shutters are up! I can already hear the cups clinking.
outro.ms-MY: Pintu besi dah naik! Saya dah boleh dengar bunyi cawan berlaga.

label.ms-MY: Buka kedai kopi Pak Cik Lim

why.en-MY: Uncle Lim has dreamed of reopening for years.
why.ms-MY: Pak Cik Lim sudah lama bermimpi untuk buka semula.

intro.en-MY: Let’s brew! Tap the kopitiam and make some kopi.
intro.ms-MY: Jom bancuh! Ketik kopitiam dan buat kopi.

outro.en-MY: Smell that? That’s a kampung waking up.
outro.ms-MY: Bau tu? Itulah bau kampung yang baru bangun.

why.en-MY: Shops turn time into goods your neighbours want.
why.ms-MY: Kedai menukar masa menjadi barangan yang jiran mahukan.

intro.en-MY: Someone pinned a note on the Papan Kenyataan! Open Orders and deliver it.
intro.ms-MY: Ada nota di Papan Kenyataan! Buka Pesanan dan hantarkannya.

outro.en-MY: Our first happy customer. You’re a natural!
outro.ms-MY: Pelanggan pertama yang gembira. Awak memang berbakat!

intro.en-MY: People want to sit outside under the arcade… What if we upgraded the kopitiam with more tables?
intro.ms-MY: Orang nak duduk di luar bawah kaki lima… Apa kata kita naik taraf kopitiam dengan lebih banyak meja?

outro.en-MY: Marble tables and round stools — just like my father had!
outro.ms-MY: Meja marmar dan bangku bulat — sama macam zaman ayah saya!

why.en-MY: Upgrades add recipes and slots — and you’ll see the shop change.
why.ms-MY: Naik taraf menambah resipi dan slot — dan anda akan nampak kedai berubah.

intro.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab, my old neighbour, has been asking for a place to grow things. A Kebun Komuniti would bring her right here!
intro.ms-MY: Mak Cik Zainab, jiran lama saya, mencari tempat untuk bercucuk tanam. Kebun Komuniti pasti bawa dia ke sini!

outro.en-MY: Zainab is here — the kampung is growing!
outro.ms-MY: Zainab dah sampai — kampung semakin berkembang!

why.en-MY: Mak Cik Zainab will move in once there’s a garden.
why.ms-MY: Mak Cik Zainab akan berpindah ke sini bila ada kebun.

intro.en-MY: A kopitiam needs good bread for roti bakar. A young baker called Mei is looking for a shop.
intro.ms-MY: Kopitiam perlukan roti yang sedap untuk roti bakar. Seorang pembuat roti muda bernama Mei sedang mencari kedai.

outro.en-MY: Mei is already kneading. What a smell!
outro.ms-MY: Mei dah mula menguli. Wanginya!

intro.en-MY: A kampung should look like the people who live in it. Plant some trees, flowers or paths!
intro.ms-MY: Kampung patut mencerminkan penduduknya. Tanamlah pokok, bunga atau buat laluan!

outro.en-MY: Now it feels like home.
outro.ms-MY: Sekarang terasa seperti rumah.

intro.en-MY: See that overgrown corner past the rain trees? The whole kampung wants to turn it into a little park — gotong-royong style. Shall we help clear it?
intro.ms-MY: Nampak sudut semak di sebalik pokok hujan itu? Seluruh kampung mahu jadikannya taman kecil — cara gotong-royong. Jom kita bantu bersihkan?

outro.en-MY: Look at it already! Everyone noticed — that’s what neighbours do.
outro.ms-MY: Tengoklah! Semua orang perasan — itulah gunanya jiran.

intro.en-MY: Flowers, benches, and then a picnic to open it. One step at a time — give whenever you have something spare.
intro.ms-MY: Bunga, bangku, kemudian kelah untuk membukanya. Selangkah demi selangkah — beri bila ada lebihan.

outro.en-MY: A picnic in our own park! Terima kasih for making this happen together.
outro.ms-MY: Berkelah di taman kita sendiri! Terima kasih kerana menjayakannya bersama.

intro.en-MY: The Papan Kenyataan is full of notes! Let’s help everyone out.
intro.ms-MY: Papan Kenyataan penuh dengan nota! Jom bantu semua orang.

outro.en-MY: Word is spreading — people love it here.
outro.ms-MY: Berita tersebar — orang suka tinggal di sini.

intro.en-MY: Upgrades need papan and bata. My friend Arjun could run a carpentry bengkel!
intro.ms-MY: Naik taraf perlukan papan dan bata. Kawan saya Arjun boleh uruskan bengkel kayu!

outro.en-MY: Arjun is sawing already. Upgrades, here we come!
outro.ms-MY: Arjun dah mula menggergaji. Naik taraf, kami datang!

intro.en-MY: The children have nowhere to study after school. My former student Kavitha could run a little learning centre.
intro.ms-MY: Budak-budak tiada tempat belajar selepas sekolah. Bekas murid saya, Kavitha, boleh uruskan pusat belajar kecil.

outro.en-MY: Listen to them laughing over the quiz! That’s the sound of learning.
outro.ms-MY: Dengar mereka ketawa semasa kuiz! Itulah bunyi orang belajar.

intro.en-MY: With a flower shop we could make jambangan for every celebration.
intro.ms-MY: Dengan kedai bunga kita boleh buat jambangan untuk setiap keraian.

outro.en-MY: Flowers for every doorstep!
outro.ms-MY: Bunga untuk setiap pintu!

intro.en-MY: In my old kampung, we built a little pavilion by the water together, so anyone could rest. Shall we start one by our tasik?
intro.ms-MY: Di kampung saya dulu, kami bina pondok kecil tepi air bersama-sama, supaya sesiapa boleh berehat. Jom kita mulakan satu tepi tasik kita?

outro.en-MY: Our pavilion — built by everyone, for everyone.
outro.ms-MY: Pondok kita — dibina oleh semua, untuk semua.

label.en-MY: Contribute to the pavilion project 3 times

intro.en-MY: A taman would give everyone a place to slow down. And Aisyah has plans…
intro.ms-MY: Sebuah taman beri semua orang tempat untuk berehat. Dan Aisyah ada rancangan…

outro.en-MY: Aisyah is already stringing up lights!
outro.ms-MY: Aisyah dah mula gantung lampu!

intro.en-MY: We’re running out of room! Let’s clear a new piece of land.
intro.ms-MY: Ruang dah tak cukup! Jom buka sebidang tanah baharu.

outro.en-MY: So much space! The possibilities…
outro.ms-MY: Luasnya! Banyak yang boleh dibuat…

label.en-MY: Unlock a new plot of land

intro.en-MY: My friend Farid restores old cars. He’d love a little showroom where people can come and look.
intro.ms-MY: Kawan saya Farid membaik pulih kereta lama. Dia mahu bilik pameran kecil tempat orang datang melihat.

outro.en-MY: Farid has polished every car twice already.
outro.ms-MY: Farid dah gilap setiap kereta dua kali.

intro.en-MY: With all this produce, we need a proper kedai runcit.
intro.ms-MY: Dengan semua hasil ini, kita perlukan kedai runcit yang betul.

outro.en-MY: The kedai runcit is open!
outro.ms-MY: Kedai runcit dah dibuka!

intro.en-MY: A photographer from Sabah, Joanna, wants to move here. She needs good light — a rumah teres!
intro.ms-MY: Seorang jurugambar dari Sabah, Joanna, mahu berpindah ke sini. Dia perlukan cahaya yang baik — sebuah rumah teres!

outro.en-MY: Joanna is already photographing the sunset.
outro.ms-MY: Joanna dah mula merakam matahari terbenam.

intro.en-MY: Every kampung needs a balai raya — for community dinners, meetings and rainy-day badminton. I’ve drawn up plans.
intro.ms-MY: Setiap kampung perlukan balai raya — untuk makan malam bersama, mesyuarat dan badminton hari hujan. Saya dah lukis pelannya.

outro.en-MY: A balai raya! Now we’re a real kampung.
outro.ms-MY: Balai raya! Sekarang kita kampung yang sebenar.

intro.en-MY: I want every neighbour to taste my kopi again. Bring me 4 cups to hand out?
intro.ms-MY: Saya mahu setiap jiran rasa kopi saya semula. Bawakan 4 cawan untuk diedarkan?

outro.en-MY: They all came back for more! I’m putting up a chalkboard menu so people know we’re open.
outro.ms-MY: Semua datang semula! Saya akan letak papan menu supaya orang tahu kita dah buka.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 4 Kopi kepada Pak Cik Lim

worldChange.en-MY: A chalkboard menu appears outside the kopitiam.
worldChange.ms-MY: Papan menu muncul di luar kopitiam.

intro.en-MY: Mei and I want to bring back the old weekend breakfast. We need 2 breakfast sets to test it.
intro.ms-MY: Saya dan Mei mahu hidupkan semula sarapan hujung minggu. Kami perlukan 2 set sarapan untuk mencuba.

outro.en-MY: Just like my father’s Sundays. Here — a kopitiam parasol for your own garden.
outro.ms-MY: Sama macam hari Ahad zaman ayah saya. Nah — payung kopitiam untuk laman awak.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 set sarapan kepada Pak Cik Lim

worldChange.en-MY: Breakfast tables now line the five-foot way.
worldChange.ms-MY: Meja sarapan kini tersusun di kaki lima.

intro.en-MY: I want to thank everyone who brought this place back. Kuih and flowers on every table…
intro.ms-MY: Saya mahu berterima kasih kepada semua yang menghidupkan tempat ini. Kuih dan bunga di setiap meja…

outro.en-MY: You made this kampung a home — for me and for everyone.
outro.ms-MY: Awak jadikan kampung ini rumah — untuk saya dan untuk semua.

label.en-MY: Bring Uncle Lim a Kuih Kelapa and a Jambangan
label.ms-MY: Bawa Kuih Kelapa dan Jambangan kepada Pak Cik Lim

worldChange.en-MY: Lantern posts are now available to light your lanes.
worldChange.ms-MY: Tiang lampu taman kini boleh menerangi lorong anda.

intro.en-MY: My coconut kuih keeps crumbling. Fresh kelapa might fix it — bring me 2?
intro.ms-MY: Kuih kelapa saya asyik hancur. Kelapa segar mungkin boleh bantu — bawakan 2?

outro.en-MY: It holds! Version twelve is the one. I’m painting it on the sign.
outro.ms-MY: Tak hancur! Versi kedua belas inilah dia. Saya akan lukis di papan tanda.

worldChange.en-MY: The bakery sign now shows Mei’s kuih.
worldChange.ms-MY: Papan tanda kedai roti kini menunjukkan kuih Mei.

intro.en-MY: Let’s hold a kuih sale for the school library fund! I need 5 Roti and 3 Kopi for the table.
intro.ms-MY: Jom buat jualan kuih untuk tabung perpustakaan sekolah! Saya perlukan 5 Roti dan 3 Kopi untuk meja.

outro.en-MY: Sold out in an hour! Take the kuih table — set it up wherever you like.
outro.ms-MY: Habis dalam sejam! Ambil meja kuih ini — letak di mana-mana awak suka.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 5 Roti dan 3 Kopi kepada Mei

intro.en-MY: The soil here is wonderful. Will you help me harvest the first bunga raya?
intro.ms-MY: Tanah di sini sangat subur. Boleh bantu saya tuai bunga raya pertama?

outro.en-MY: Look at them! The kebun is truly alive.
outro.ms-MY: Tengok! Kebun ini benar-benar hidup.

intro.en-MY: Imagine flowers along every lorong… Could you plant 3 flower beds?
intro.ms-MY: Bayangkan bunga di sepanjang setiap lorong… Boleh tanam 3 batas bunga?

outro.en-MY: The butterflies found them already! Here, a bird bath — the bulbuls deserve a treat too.
outro.ms-MY: Rama-rama dah jumpa! Nah, kolam burung — burung merbah pun patut dapat hadiah.

worldChange.en-MY: Butterflies now gather around your flower beds.
worldChange.ms-MY: Rama-rama kini berkumpul di batas bunga anda.

intro.en-MY: Lim works so hard. Let’s surprise him — bring me 2 jambangan?
intro.ms-MY: Lim bekerja keras. Jom kejutkan dia — bawakan 2 jambangan?

outro.en-MY: He pretended he had dust in his eye. You’re a good friend.
outro.ms-MY: Dia buat-buat ada habuk masuk mata. Awak kawan yang baik.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Jambangan kepada Mak Cik Zainab

intro.en-MY: Let’s get this bengkel humming. Cut 4 papan with me?
intro.ms-MY: Jom hidupkan bengkel ini. Potong 4 papan dengan saya?

outro.en-MY: Now that’s a stack to be proud of!
outro.ms-MY: Itu timbunan yang membanggakan!

intro.en-MY: Opening day! I need a jambangan for the stage and 3 kopi for the volunteers.
intro.ms-MY: Hari perasmian! Saya perlukan jambangan untuk pentas dan 3 kopi untuk sukarelawan.

outro.en-MY: Best. Opening. Ever. The taman is officially open!
outro.ms-MY: Perasmian. Paling. Hebat. Taman dah dibuka secara rasmi!

label.en-MY: Bring Aisyah a Jambangan and 3 Kopi
label.ms-MY: Bawa Jambangan dan 3 Kopi kepada Aisyah

worldChange.en-MY: Bunting is strung across the taman.

intro.en-MY: Will you be my first student? Answer 3 quiz questions — right or wrong, it all counts.
intro.ms-MY: Sudikah awak jadi murid pertama saya? Jawab 3 soalan kuiz — betul atau salah, semuanya dikira.

outro.en-MY: Wonderful! You asked better questions than you answered — that’s the best kind of student.
outro.ms-MY: Hebat! Soalan awak lebih bagus daripada jawapan — itulah murid yang terbaik.

intro.en-MY: Help me arrange the display? Try a few colours — let’s make it feel like a garden.
intro.ms-MY: Bantu saya susun pameran? Cuba beberapa warna — jom buat rasa macam taman.

outro.en-MY: Look at that — people are stopping just to smile at it.
outro.ms-MY: Tengok tu — orang berhenti semata-mata untuk tersenyum.

title.ms-MY: Selamat Hari Jadi, Pak Cik Lim

intro.en-MY: Uncle Lim’s birthday is on Saturday and he keeps pretending he forgot. Shh — help me with a surprise? I need 2 Kuih Kelapa and a Jambangan.
intro.ms-MY: Hari jadi Pak Cik Lim hari Sabtu dan dia buat-buat lupa. Shh — tolong saya buat kejutan? Saya perlukan 2 Kuih Kelapa dan sejambak Jambangan.

outro.en-MY: His face! He laughed so hard he nearly dropped his cup. Then he made everyone kopi “because it’s my party”.
outro.ms-MY: Muka dia! Dia ketawa sampai hampir terjatuh cawan. Lepas itu dia bancuh kopi untuk semua “sebab ini parti saya”.

label.en-MY: Bring Mei 2 Kuih Kelapa and a Jambangan
label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Kuih Kelapa dan Jambangan kepada Mei

intro.en-MY: New idea: kaya with a little gula melaka swirl. Uncle Lim says “no need to change perfection”. I say… taste test! 2 Kaya and 2 Kelapa, please.
intro.ms-MY: Idea baharu: kaya dengan sedikit pusaran gula melaka. Pak Cik Lim kata “tak perlu ubah yang sempurna”. Saya kata… uji rasa! 2 Kaya dan 2 Kelapa, ya.

outro.en-MY: Verdict: Uncle Lim had four slices “for science”. Version thirteen is now a secret menu item.
outro.ms-MY: Keputusan: Pak Cik Lim makan empat keping “untuk sains”. Versi tiga belas kini menu rahsia.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Kaya dan 2 Kelapa kepada Mei

intro.en-MY: Biscuit has escaped into my flower beds again! She only comes out for roti. Could you bring 2 Roti — quickly, before she reaches the orchids?
intro.ms-MY: Biskut terlepas ke batas bunga saya lagi! Dia cuma keluar kalau ada roti. Boleh bawa 2 Roti — cepat, sebelum dia sampai ke orkid?

outro.en-MY: Found her asleep under the hibiscus with a petal on her nose. Unforgivable. And completely adorable.
outro.ms-MY: Jumpa dia tidur di bawah bunga raya dengan kelopak di hidungnya. Tak boleh dimaafkan. Dan sangat comel.

label.ms-MY: Bawa 2 Roti kepada Mak Cik Zainab

intro.en-MY: I know the light here better than the people! Would you introduce me around? Say hello to a few neighbours with me.
intro.ms-MY: Saya lebih kenal cahaya di sini daripada orangnya! Boleh kenalkan saya? Jom tegur beberapa jiran bersama saya.

outro.en-MY: Everyone said hi! Mak Cik Zainab gave me cuttings and Aisyah already put me on three committees.
outro.ms-MY: Semua orang tegur! Mak Cik Zainab beri keratan pokok dan Aisyah dah masukkan saya dalam tiga jawatankuasa.

intro.en-MY: The football kids keep asking for a playground. If we all chip in at the bare lot, I’ll build the slide myself. Help it along twice?
intro.ms-MY: Budak-budak bola sepak asyik minta taman permainan. Kalau kita semua menyumbang di tanah lapang itu, saya bina gelongsor sendiri. Bantu dua kali?

outro.en-MY: They tested the slide forty-seven times. Officially approved.
outro.ms-MY: Mereka uji gelongsor itu empat puluh tujuh kali. Lulus secara rasmi.

label.ms-MY: Bantu di taman permainan dua kali

intro.en-MY: The pocket park needs an opening picnic and I have a list. A long list. First item: you! Help finish Taman Poket?
intro.ms-MY: Taman poket perlukan kelah pembukaan dan saya ada senarai. Senarai panjang. Perkara pertama: awak! Bantu siapkan Taman Poket?

outro.en-MY: Mats, kuih, kites and the whole kampung on the grass. I didn’t even need the clipboard. (I used it anyway.)
outro.ms-MY: Tikar, kuih, wau dan seluruh kampung di atas rumput. Saya tak perlukan papan klip pun. (Tapi saya guna juga.)

description.en-MY: Aisyah and Mak Cik Zainab are filling the lanes with flowers! Join in at your own pace — every goal you reach adds festival rewards.
description.ms-MY: Aisyah dan Mak Cik Zainab memenuhi lorong dengan bunga! Sertai mengikut rentak sendiri — setiap matlamat menambah ganjaran pesta.

description.en-MY: Tables line the lorong and everyone brings something to share — kopi, roti and kuih. Cook, serve and taste your way through the day.
description.ms-MY: Meja-meja memenuhi lorong dan semua orang membawa sesuatu untuk dikongsi — kopi, roti dan kuih. Masak, hidang dan rasa sepanjang hari.

description.en-MY: Arjun brought his guitar, Aisyah a kompang… Light up the lanes, chat with neighbours and enjoy the music.
description.ms-MY: Arjun bawa gitar, Aisyah bawa kompang… Terangi lorong, berbual dengan jiran dan nikmati muzik.

description.en-MY: The new pocket park is ready for its first party: bunga raya on every table, little gifts and a lot of laughter.
description.ms-MY: Taman poket baharu sedia untuk parti pertamanya: bunga raya di setiap meja, hadiah kecil dan banyak gelak tawa.

description.en-MY: Stalls light up the new plaza: kaya, roti, produce baskets and neighbours swapping stories. Bring your best goods!
description.ms-MY: Gerai-gerai menerangi dataran baharu: kaya, roti, bakul hasil tani dan jiran bertukar cerita. Bawa barangan terbaik anda!

description.en-MY: Bows, bandanas and a very proud parade around the playground. Treat the pets and cheer them on!
description.ms-MY: Reben, selendang dan perarakan yang sangat bangga di sekitar taman permainan. Beri haiwan peliharaan habuan dan sorak untuk mereka!

description.en-MY: A screen goes up at Bukit Senja for an outdoor film. Kopi, kuih, mats on the grass and a funny old movie under the stars.
description.ms-MY: Skrin dipasang di Bukit Senja untuk wayang pacak. Kopi, kuih, tikar di atas rumput dan filem lama yang lucu di bawah bintang.

description.en-MY: Another year of Kampung Seri! Everyone pitches in to make the kampung look its very best for the big day.
description.ms-MY: Setahun lagi untuk Kampung Seri! Semua orang bergotong-royong supaya kampung kelihatan paling cantik untuk hari besar.

description.en-MY: Help the kampung build an open-sided pavilion by the tasik, so anyone can sit and rest there. Every contribution brings it a step closer.
description.ms-MY: Bantu kampung membina pondok terbuka di tepi tasik, supaya sesiapa boleh duduk berehat. Setiap sumbangan membawanya selangkah lebih dekat.

description.en-MY: Complete a community landmark.
description.ms-MY: Siapkan mercu tanda komuniti.

history.en-MY: You moved into your Rumah Kampung.
history.ms-MY: Anda berpindah ke Rumah Kampung anda.
